description: This Java class 'Size' provides a utility for handling dimensions, including width and height, for image or camera sizes within the TensorFlow Android demo environment. It includes methods for parsing size strings, rotating sizes, computing aspect ratios, and converting size lists to strings.

classes.name: Size
classes.description: Represents a rectangular size with width and height, supporting comparison, serialization, and utility methods.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Constructor to initialize size with width and height.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Constructor to initialize size based on a Bitmap object.

methods.name: getRotatedSize
methods.description: Returns a new Size object rotated by the specified degrees (0, 90, 180, 270).

methods.name: parseFromString
methods.description: Parses a size from a string formatted as 'widthxheight'. Returns null if parsing fails.

methods.name: sizeStringToList
methods.description: Converts a comma-separated list of size strings into a List of Size objects.

methods.name: sizeListToString
methods.description: Converts a list of Size objects into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: aspectRatio
methods.description: Calculates and returns the aspect ratio (width divided by height).

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this Size to another based on total pixel count.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object, true if same width and height.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on width and height.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of size in 'widthxheight' format.

methods.name: dimensionsAsString
methods.description: Generates a string in 'widthxheight' format from given dimensions.
